# video46 reconstruction report (L1 / Proxy, CineRecon Three.js sampled-frame baseline)

Round 001 (initial scene, no render feedback received yet).

## Observed in the 24 reference samples
- One continuous third-person follow shot (no cuts), 10.6 s at 60 fps, 1280x720.
- 0.0-0.47 s: hooded runner (dark torso, white hood/skirt, yellow cape, bow on back) runs toward a closed stone gate with a reddish lintel; a dark guard kneels on the gate top.
- 0.92 s: runner climbs the gate face; 1.38 s: runner is on top, guard lying dead beside him (ledge kill); 1.83 s: runner stands on the gate top above a lower terrace.
- 2.3 s: runner jumps down onto the terrace (merlon parapets left/right, brazier); 2.77-3.2 s: runner turns left to a large staircase; camera swings ~90 degrees to follow.
- 3.2-4.6 s: runner climbs the stairs; 5.07-6.0 s: crouched advance on an upper platform with a fence ahead and on the right, brazier at the corner.
- 6.45-8.75 s: crouch-walk to image-left along the fence (side-on view); 9.2-10.58 s: runner turns onto a long walkway with merlons on its left and a fence on its right, runs then crouches.

## Reconstruction choices
- Geometry: boxes/cylinders/spheres for gate block, door posts, lintel, walls, merlon rows, fences (panels), stairs (14 step boxes), upper platform, walkway, braziers, palms, rock cliffs, distant town blocks, tower, hills, vegetation/water flats.
- Articulation: both characters are hierarchical proxies (hips, spine, head, shoulders/elbows, hips/knees, feet; hero has cape and bow). Poses: run, stair-run, leap, climb, crouch-on-top, stand, jump, landing, crouch-walk; guard kneel -> tipped/prone death at ~1.0-1.3 s. ## Inference vs observation
- Exact layout between samples, the guard's exact kill motion, stair dimensions and the hero's path between samples are inferred. HUD/watermark text is intentionally not reproduced.
